_about: Visitor-facing words for product slotting (Step 5a). The server fills every {placeholder} with real counts from the run; no number is written here. labels: grid headers for the two columns slotting adds. slot: the Slot column's text. steps: the running commentary, one entry per step kind, in run order ('name' while the step runs, 'line' once it is done); spec-story steps repeat once per story family in spec_stories.toml. stories: each family's display label, optional step words, and the hover card's reason it fits. reasons: why a loan is not slotted (short for the grid, text for the hover card). card: the hover card's generic TBA line. Rules and their numbers live in backend/app/config/slotting.toml and spec_stories.toml; terms are defined in content/glossary.json. Everything is illustrative.
